description: Get the content of the current page. Set format="markdown" for clean markdown with structure preserved — preferred for LLM consumption. Returns up to maxChars (default 20000); pass offset to page through long pages.

format.description: Output format. "text" = raw innerText. "markdown" = clean markdown (headings/links/lists, nav/footer/ads stripped) — better for LLM consumption.

maxChars.description: Max characters returned (default 20000). Response notes total size when truncated.

offset.description: Character offset to continue a previously truncated read.

selector.description: Read one article or result container instead of the whole page. Must match exactly one element.

sessionId.description: Browser session ID. If omitted, auto-selects the only open session.

tabId.description: Target a specific tab within the session. Auto-resolved from environment if omitted.

name: browser_content
